item.title: Prayer and Support After Air Crash
item.description: Following the tragic June 12 Air India plane crash near Ahmedabad, Catholic dioceses across India have held masses and prayer vigils, and assisted in preparing coffins for the victims

item.title: Catholics protest attacks on clergy in India
item.description: The Kerala Latin Catholic Association (KLCA) organized statewide protests on June 8 to condemn violent attacks on priests in Odisha. One victim, 90‑year‑old Fr. Leenus Puthanveetil, survived a knife-point assault. The association and local politicians, including Congress leader V.D. Satheesan, are advocating for justice and protection

item.title: Two Kerala Nuns Granted Bail After Arrest in Chhattisgarh on False Trafficking Charges
item.description: Two Catholic nuns from Kerala—Sisters Preethi Mary and Vandana Francis—were released on conditional bail after being arrested in Durg, Chhattisgarh, on July 25 under allegations of human trafficking and forced religious conversion.
